text:
claire: Published JS SDK @redwood/js-sdk v1.4.0 and Python client redwood-client v0.9.3 to npm/PyPI. Release notes pushed to GH. rolling to prod now. @release-manager heads up.

deploy-bot: npm publish succeeded: @redwood/js-sdk@1.4.0
PyPI upload succeeded: redwood-client==0.9.3

matt: quick smoke - TS build in internal dashboard complains: named exports missing from bundle, import errors. anyone else seeing this?

alex: saw a Sentry error: `Cannot find export 'Stream' from package`. looks like an exports/module field mismatch in the ESM build.
samir: we need a decision: rollback to 1.3.8 or hotfix + republish (1.4.1)? change window closed until 17:00 PST but this is customer-facing. rollback if multiple customers affected or CI broken.
claire: is CJS impacted or only ESM?
alex: CJS imports fine. ESM `import { Stream } from '@redwood/js-sdk'` fails. quick fix is to tweak the `exports` map and rebuild with the proper rollup output. i can patch + republish.
matt: if we republish, bump patch (1.4.1) and deprecate 1.4.0 with `npm deprecate @redwood/js-sdk@1.4.0 \"broken ESM exports, use 1.4.1\"` — npm unpublish is not an option for older packages.
release-manager: prefer hotfix to minimize fallout. alex, please prepare 1.4.1. timeline: try to publish within 30m. if publish fails we'll roll back to 1.3.8 and reopen shiproom.
alex: ack. running CI locally, rebuilding with `export.rollupOutput = { ... }` fix, then `npm publish --access public`. will update release notes and add migration snippet. ETA ~20m.
deploy-bot: note: registry safety rules: npm unpublish disallowed for >72h, deprecate recommended. PyPI has stricter policies — use yanked respins if needed. twine token required for PyPI.
samir: i'm opening an emergency change window for 30m to allow the patch publish. @devex-claire can you double-check PyPI artifacts?
claire: confirmed py package (0.9.3) only had a docs tweak, no runtime break. focusing on JS patch.
alex: published @redwood/js-sdk@1.4.1 and ran local smoke tests. running `npm deprecate @redwood/js-sdk@1.4.0 \"broken ESM exports, use 1.4.1\"` now.
matt: quick canary roll looks green in internal apps, error rate back to baseline. i'll keep an eye for 30m.
claire: thanks team. updating release-notes + changelog with deprecation and migration note. closing this thread after 1h of green unless new regressions appear. :thumbsup:
